description: This file defines a Python class 'LocalSmartTurnAnalyzer' that uses PyTorch and Hugging Face transformers to perform on-device end-of-turn detection for audio data, utilizing a Wav2Vec2-BERT model architecture. It includes model loading, preprocessing, and inference methods, and is part of a smart turn analysis module.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzer
classes.description: A class that performs local end-of-turn detection using a PyTorch model, supporting offline operation with audio sequence classification.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the analyzer, loads the model and feature extractor, and sets the device.

methods.name: _predict_endpoint
methods.description: Performs inference on an audio array to predict end-of-turn status and probability.
